title: SIMPLIFY-TICKETS
prompt: Simplify the ticket mechanism to remove checkpoints and interactions. All computation that was performed on a checkpoint (affected sections with line metrics and the list of affected definitions.) should be performed when finishing a ticket. Add a summary field and files as necessary arguments for the ticket close command.
